text:
zara: Quick sync  support tickets keep asking: what exactly does preview do vs apply? Need a concise contract and minimum telemetry.

marta: Agreed. Right now console shows a diff + simulated routing but no stable id or replay handle. That's the main ask.

dyson: Important constraint: preview cannot emit production SLO metrics. It must be strictly non-invasive. We can emit audit events and low-sample telemetry.

laura: API proposal: POST /v1/configs/preview -> 200 { preview_id, diff, simulation_summary, warnings }. preview_id must be returned and included in a response header X-Preview-Id for easy correlation.

ankur: Telemetry sampling: default 1% for general previews. Add a schema-level flag for sensitive keys (auth, quota, kms, billing). If present, server escalates to 100% logging and marks the event tag preview.sensitive=true.

kevin: UX: console should display a persistent "PREVIEW (not applied)" chip with preview_id, a small copy of the diff, and two actions: "Promote -> Canary" and "Export snapshot". Promote should preserve the exact delta and cohort definition.

marta: Also add an immutable preview snapshot stored with preview_id so audits can replay the same simulator inputs later.

zara: What about preflight? Teams expect an apply to fail fast on impossible constraints.

dyson: Add X-Config-Mode header: preview|preflight|apply. Preflight runs the same simulator synchronously (5s timeout). It performs validation + capacity guard but avoids emitting production metrics. If preflight fails, return 409 with structured guidance.

laura: Example curl: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/configs \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $T' \ 
  -H 'X-Config-Mode: preflight' \ 
  -d '{"target":"us-east-1","config":{...}}'
```

laura: Response on failure 409 should include failing_constraints[], estimated_impact{qps,cost}, and remediation_suggestions[].

ankur: Capacity guard details: compare expected QPS to pool_available_qps * headroom (default headroom 25%). If expected > cap*headroom -> preflight fail. Return the exact pool id and recommended actions: increase pool, enable fallback routes, or reduce cohort size.

marta: Telemetry event names we should emit: config.preview.request (sampled), config.preview.sensitive (full), config.preflight.result (pass|fail), config.apply.attempt. All events must carry preview_id/preflight_id/apply_id.

kevin: Edge case: a preview followed by apply from a different actor. We must record actor in audit and allow console to show "promoted from preview X by actor Y at ts". Also provide a revert token on apply (apply_id) that can be used to trigger an automated rollback snapshot.

dyson: Implementation note: preview snapshots are immutable. When promoting, we create an apply_id that references the snapshot and record the exact server-side diff. Revert uses the snapshot to reverse changes. Revert token is permission-gated.

zara: Ops ask: will previews count against quota or usage budgets?

ankur: No. Previews do not decrement usage quotas nor affect billing metrics. Only applies and live canaries affect quotas/usage dashboards. Preflight also does not affect quotas.

ops-bot: Reminder: config deploy window Tue 02:00 UTC. Preflight must finish before window to be eligible for that window.

marta: Action items: laura -> draft API spec and sample responses + header behavior; dyson/ankur -> backend: audit events, sampling escalation, preflight capacity guard, immutable snapshot store + apply/revert linkage; kevin -> console mocks: preview badge, promote/export/replay UX; zara -> write short support KB clarifying semantics. I'll open an RFC with wire schema and telemetry names.

zara: Thanks all. Tagging @dyson @laura @ankur @kevin. :thumbsup:
